about: Jerry can in the main hand, first and third person alike. Carried at the side by the middle handle. Pouring (seconds = the pour's ticks / 20, rewound twice as fast after it stops, client/skeleton/SkeletonActions): the body steps up to 0.5 block from the fill opening, a little to its right (side -0.15, so the left hand reaches the tipped can's spout end), crouches only for a low opening (the spout under 0.75 over the feet; the portable genset is poured standing) and leans to it (up to 40 deg: the parameter), the can comes up across the belly with the left hand at the cap, the cap swings open on its hinge, and the can tips with its spout held over the opening (anchor spout: 0.2 above it, at least 0.65 over the feet); the right hand goes to the rear handle and, once the cap is open, the left hand to the middle handle, both hands on the handles as a can is poured, so the stream (from the drawn spout, client/FuelCanPourJets) falls straight in at 3.4 s (item/FuelCanItem POUR_DELAY). The view is locked on the opening while pouring (client/JerryCanPourView: from the camera eye, at most 50 deg down; the first-person camera does not follow the head's pitch, skeleton/action/ActionPose#cameraEye). docs/dev/player_actions_v1_plan.md 11, 12
